chunks: That (Hell) is surely one of the greater (signs),
ai.seo_question: What does the term 'al-Kubar' refer to in Shia hadith regarding Hell?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this phrase from Surah Al-Muddaththir is often interpreted as Hell being one of the 'greater' (al-Kubar) among the signs of the Day of Judgment or the major categories of divine retribution, emphasizing its magnitude as a deterrent. Scholars highlight its role in affirming the reality of the Hereafter and the severity of sin, serving as a theological anchor for understanding the scale of divine justice.
